name: oh-my-space
description: Manage multi-repo workspaces with Git submodules.

scripts.test:unit: npm run test:inventory && npm run test:compile && node scripts/run-test-layer.mjs .test-dist/tests/unit unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:inventory && npm run test:compile && node scripts/run-test-layer.mjs .test-dist/tests/integration integration
scripts.test:blackbox: npm run test:inventory && npm run build && node scripts/run-test-layer.mjs tests blackbox
scripts.test:preparation: npm run test:inventory && npm run build && node --test tests/cli-preparation-*.test.js
scripts.test:scaffold: npm run test:inventory && npm run build && node --test tests/cli-scaffold.test.js
scripts.test:sync: npm run test:inventory && npm run build && node --test tests/cli-sync-*.test.js
scripts.test:commit: npm run test:inventory && npm run build && node --test tests/cli-commit-*.test.js
scripts.test:branch: npm run test:inventory && npm run build && node --test tests/cli-branch*.test.js
scripts.test:tools: npm run test:inventory && npm run build && node --test tests/cli-tools.test.js
